analyst.text: Toronto have lost 13 straight to New York going back to January 2023, and their recurring problem has been letting games slip late. Scottie Barnes is back from his adductor strain, but Kawhi Leonard is still out with left knee swelling and Nate Bittle is also sidelined, while the defending-champion Knicks report a clean injury list.
